name: Forge Core Engineering
description: Deterministic Python coding tasks in one pinned, isolated fixture repository.

tasks.title: Inclusive clamp
tasks.instruction: Fix forgebench.clamp so values above high return high. Preserve values inside the inclusive bounds. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Validate TCP port
tasks.instruction: Make forgebench.parse_port reject non-decimal text and values outside 1..65535 with ValueError. Keep valid decimal ports as integers. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Normalize slugs
tasks.instruction: Extend forgebench.slug to trim surrounding whitespace and collapse internal whitespace into single hyphens while lowercasing. Preserve letters and digits. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Safe division
tasks.instruction: Make forgebench.safe_divide return None when denominator is zero while retaining normal division for nonzero values. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Guard state transitions
tasks.instruction: Implement transition rules in forgebench.transition: pending + start -> running, running + finish -> done, and all other pairs unchanged. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Skip blank rows
tasks.instruction: Make forgebench.parse_rows ignore empty or whitespace-only lines and trim each comma-separated cell. Keep empty cells within nonblank rows. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Stable deduplication
tasks.instruction: Make forgebench.dedupe remove duplicate strings while preserving their first-seen order. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Bound retry delay
tasks.instruction: Cap forgebench.retry_delay at 8 seconds and reject negative attempts with ValueError. Keep attempts 0..3 unchanged. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Select supported runtime
tasks.instruction: Find the runtime selector in this repository. Make choose_runtime select python for .py, node for .js and .ts, case-insensitively; reject unsupported extensions with ValueError. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Exact output bound
tasks.instruction: Make limit_output return at most limit bytes, reject a negative limit with ValueError, and preserve shorter data. Edit only forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Keep API port contract
tasks.instruction: Update api.build_server_config and forgebench.parse_port together: blank input must use port 8000; explicit input must be a valid TCP port; keep host 127.0.0.1. Edit only api.py and forgebench.py.

tasks.title: Bound worker schedule
tasks.instruction: Update worker.retry_schedule and forgebench.retry_delay: reject negative or more than five attempts, and cap delays at 8 seconds. Preserve the existing first four delays. Edit only worker.py and forgebench.py.
